observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo '=== admin /admin ==='
curl -sk --resolve admin.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' https://admin.localhost/admin/
echo '=== API login (admin user) ==='
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin!LocalDev123"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("access",""))' 2>/dev/null)
echo "token_len=${#TOKEN}"
echo "$TOKEN" > /tmp/token.txt
echo '=== auth/user with token ==='
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/user/ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
echo
echo '=== projects list with token ==='
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/projects/ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | head -c 400
echo
echo '=== tilejson ==='
curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://tiles.localhost/
curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://tiles.localhost/ | head -c 300
echo
echo '=== tile 2/1/1 ==='
curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} type=%{content_type} size=%{size_download}\n' https://tiles.localhost/tiles/2/1/1.png
echo '=== WebDAV ==='
curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w 'unauth: HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://files.localhost/
curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X PROPFIND -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w 'propfind: HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://files.localhost/
